## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible or protocol impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `testDebugUnitTest` passes
- [ ] `lintDebug` passes
- [ ] `assembleDebug` passes
- [ ] New or changed protocol logic has deterministic tests
- [ ] Relevant documentation and backend capability declarations are updated
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, private diagnostics, documents, serial numbers, or local paths are included
- [ ] No fabricated printer compatibility claims were added
- [ ] Production code does not use `FakeUsbTransport`

## Hardware evidence

If this changes a hardware claim, provide the exact printer model, Android/OTG environment, backend/settings, redacted diagnostics, and observed physical output. Leave this section as not tested when no physical test was performed.
